##Exercise 1


Question
========
Given a table STUDENTS: 
+------+--------+------+
| ID   | Name   | Age  |
+======+========+======+
| 1    | Anna   | 22   |
+------+--------+------+
| 2    | Ben    | 21   |
+------+--------+------+
1. Write a query to select  **all** students

```{sql}
SELECT * 
FROM Students;
```
